FN-119GVLL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 175
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/02/2026
REVISED
House Bill 175 as introduced could reduce income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by a
maximum of $2 million annually, for Fiscal Years 2028 through Fiscal Year 2032 by
establishing an income tax credit of up to $5,000 that may be claimed by certain eligible donors
who donate edible farm products to a qualifying food bank. This bill provides that these credits
1) are not refundable or transferable; 2) may not be carried forward; and 3) are available for tax
years 2027 though 2030.
